units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 269:12">Sifré Deut. 269</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 24:1">Deut. XXIV, 1</cite>) <he>שיהא כורת מכאן … אין זה כ׳</he> he must make the thing final, from this we derive that if a man says, this is thy letter of divorce under the condition that thou wilt never go …, this is no final (valid) divorce; <cite ref="Gittin 83b:20">Gitt. 83ᵇ</cite>. Tosef. ib. IX (VII), 1; a. fr.—Gitt. l. c.; ib. 21ᵇ; <cite ref="Sukkah 24b:8">Succ. 24ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>כרת כ׳</he> the legal deduction from the use of the word <cite ref="K01182"><he>כריתות</he></cite> (Deut. l. c.) where the word <cite ref="K01282"><he>כָּרֵת</he></cite> might have been used.
